title: vllm_worker - Mixtral - Tokenizer points to TokenizerGroup object
body:
When self.tokenizer is referred to in the vllm_worker, it points to a TokenizerGroup object, which has no attributes / functions such as eos_token_id or decode.

This can be rectified by initialising

self.tokenizer = llm_engine.engine.tokenizer.tokenizer,

instead of

self.tokenizer = llm_engine.engine.tokenizer (Which is existing right now)

This is only observed for the Mixtral model right now, but not for other models. So, it is required to implement checks whether the type is a TokenizerGroup, if yes, do this.
